17: package uk.gov.hmrc.softdrinksindustrylevy.models
18: 
19: import play.api.libs.json._
20: import scala.language.implicitConversions
21: 
22: /** Utility class for creating json formatters for enumerations.
23:   */
24: object EnumUtils {
25:   def enumReads[E <: Enumeration](`enum`: E): Reads[`enum`.Value] = new Reads[`enum`.Value] {
26:     def reads(json: JsValue): JsResult[`enum`.Value] = json match {
27:       case JsString(s) =>
28:         try
29:           JsSuccess(`enum`.withName(s))
30:         catch {
31:           case _: NoSuchElementException =>
32:             JsError(
33:               s"Enumeration expected of type: '${`enum`.getClass}'," ++
34:                 s" but it does not appear to contain the value: '$s'"
35:             )
36:         }
37:       case _ => JsError("String value expected")
38:     }
39:   }
40: 
41:   implicit def enumWrites[E <: Enumeration](`enum`: E): Writes[`enum`.Value] = new Writes[`enum`.Value] {
42:     def writes(v: `enum`.Value): JsValue = JsString(v.toString)
43:   }
44: 
45:   implicit def enumFormat[E <: Enumeration](`enum`: E): Format[`enum`.Value] =
46:     Format(enumReads(`enum`), enumWrites(`enum`))
47: 
48: }
